description: Vodafone Portugal, Digital Engineering: the team's deck shell as a theme. Near-black stage with red technical grids, three drifting glows, rising red particles and a vignette; the speechmark lockup with the Portuguese flag top-left, deck title with section and page top-right, a mono legal line at the foot; Vodafone type over a system fallback stack; red rationed to eyebrows, numerals, rules, corner marks and callouts. Ambient loops in the connective tissue only, static under print and reduced motion.

requires.note: Supply the licensed Vodafone fonts through private installation assets. The original speechmark and flag are included.
